_comment: Input of pfr_runner.py for air in an unheated pipe (adiabatic wall, friction on). python pfr_runner.py pfr_air_adiabatic.json
_case: Same tube as pfr_air.json without wall heating: air at 300 K, 2 bar, 50 m/s into a 30 mm tube, adiabatic, Petukhov friction (Fanno flow)
_wall_htc_Wm2K: a number [W/m2/K], 0 = adiabatic, or "gnielinski" (local Re and Pr, fully developed; laminar Nu 3.66)
_wall_friction: Darcy friction in the momentum equation: Petukhov, laminar 64/Re
_wall_temperature_profile: wall T(x), Main_1 knot format: position relative 0..1, 'step' holds the knot value to the next knot, 'linear' ramps to it; unused when wall_htc_Wm2K is 0
